summary: Vertical image resampler. Blends each source pixel with a neighboring row using a 3:1 weighted convolution (shifts by 4) to produce output rows. Processes exactly two source-row pairs per output row. When channel count (a2+40) differs from 2, an interior loop blends the remaining channels of each pixel.

If row count a1[68] (this+0x110) > 0, process output rows; otherwise return early.
Inner loop processes exactly two source-row pairs (pairIndex < 2) per output row.
Read center pixel byte v5 = *result (obj+0x0) and neighbor pixel byte v6 from adjacent row (obj+0x0 of neighbor).
Compute first weighted blend v8 = neighborChannel + 3 * centerChannel for channel 0.
Compute next-channel weighted blend v11 = nextNeighborChannel + 3 * nextCenterChannel using obj+0x1 channel bytes.
Write blended result bytes to destination pixel v7 = *(indexTable + 4 * rowIndex), including obj+0x2-derived channel outputs.
If channel count (a2+40) != 2, run the interior blend loop for remaining channels.
Interior loop blends successive channel bytes with (3*prev + cur + offset) >> 4 pattern until channel counter reaches 1.
Emit tail pixel bytes *v14 = (v11 + v8 + 2*v11 + 8) >> 4 and v14[1] = (4*v11 + 7) >> 4.
Outer loop advances output row pointer and rowIndex until rowIndex >= row count a1[68] (this+0x110).
